text: Entry 2045 removes the old accountHubHeaderSubHeader paragraph/slot and its CSS while reworking header/body spacing. The frozen template again has a hidden h2 with ID accountHubHeaderSubheader and class sub-view-sub-header. The name and element role differ from the removed paragraph. Treat the original deletion as that landing’s layout choice, not a general ban on subheaders or a license to remove current caller-visible markup. The design-document comments linked by the commit were not read; no claim is made about their requested or approved changes. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending-single-browser-reader.
title: The Account Hub subheader removal is historical rather than a permanent markup rule
